messages.subject: dynamically created input issue
parts:
Hi Guys,

I am trying to build app which has dynamically created input based on names of the data frame given in the input. Please see code below 


    output$sliders <- renderUI({
        numSliders <- ncol(get(input$dataset))
        names <- names(get(input$dataset))
        lapply(1:numSliders, function(i) {
            numericInput(
                inputId = paste0('column', i),
                label = paste0('Weight for ', names[i]),
                value =1,
                min = 0,
                max = 100,
                step =1)
        })
    })


Can you tell me how to get those values from input. suppose I want to build a loop in which I will use
paste("column",i). How to get those values?


Many Thanks,
Damian

messages.author: b1d59d829ab1e17e
messages.subject: Re: dynamically created input issue
parts:
I think I've hound a solution:

    output$hist_t4 <- renderPlot({
        dat <- get(input$dataset)
        y<-0
        for(i in 1:ncol(dat)){
            x <- dat[,i]*as.numeric(input[[paste0("column",i)]])[1]
            y<-y+x
        }
        hist(y)

    })

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: dynamically created input issue
parts:
Yeah, the [[ indexing is correct. I would encourage you to make the get() call more specific though:

get(input$dataset, pos = "package:datasets", inherits = FALSE)

This will ensure that input$dataset can't be manipulated into exposing an object you didn't want exposed.
